response: The c-Kit-dependent growth of uveal melanoma cells has been identified as a potential therapeutic target. Research has shown that c-Kit is vastly expressed in uveal melanoma, suggesting that the c-Kit molecular pathway plays a significant role in the growth of these cells. As a result, targeting this pathway with therapies such as STI571 may be an effective treatment approach for uveal melanoma. This could provide a new avenue for therapy and potentially improve outcomes for patients with this type of cancer.
